output:
Implemented the **Texture by model** tab end-to-end: KV take records, `model_takes` / `model_generate` RPCs, snapshot includes model projects, and a dedicated panel UI with i18n.

### Summary
- **`server.ts`**: `model_takes` (thumbnails from project host), `model_generate` (same path as the agent tool), KV records on texture-uv/blueprint completion; snapshot no longer drops `section: "model"`.
- **`src/model.ts`**: take record schema, snapshot/tab filtering helpers, parts text parser.
- **`model-panel.tsx`**: project picker, texture-uv and blueprint forms, takes gallery (guide/color/preview or blueprint views).
- **`app.tsx`**: `model` nav tab wired to `ModelPanel`.
- **`i18n.ts`**: `tabModel` and form labels (en/ru).
- **`gui-panel.tsx`**: exported `ProjectPicker` for reuse.
- **`tests/model-panel.test.ts`**: snapshot, tab filtering, take records, RPC presence.

Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` and `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts` (243 tests).

```plan-fact
[
  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:npx tsc --noEmit"]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["tests/model-panel.test.ts:1-75","cmd:node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["app.tsx:1108-1345","model-panel.tsx:1-420","i18n.ts:296-337","server.ts:305-343","server.ts:2720-2795"]}
]
```

APPROACH: Reused `gui-panel` patterns (project picker, theme block, generate form) and hooked generation into existing `runModelTextureUv` / `runModelBlueprint` with per-project KV take lists and host-file thumbnails for the gallery.

LESSON: Keeping model projects in the full snapshot while filtering per tab in `stylesForAppTab` avoids a second styles channel and keeps Roblox/GUI/Characters lists unchanged.

dispatchContext.memoryText:
- Project-life bookkeeping commits run only on main. PM writes to .agents/PROGRESS.md and .agents/CHANGELOG.md are guarded; PM guidance points to .agents/decisions/ and .agents/plans/.
- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. Transient tables (exports, pending_exports, project_moves, thread_moves, section_moves) are excluded. This adds no schema changes and preserves the existing appearance-only export/import flow.
- Lane Pilot theme project: `themes/pokecut.css` is generated from `src/theme/base.css`. After editing the source, run `npm run build:theme`; `node scripts/build-theme.mjs --check` must exit 0. Also run `npm run typecheck` and `node --experimental-strip-types --test theme.test.ts`.
